messages.text:
The generated verifier also exposed a verifier-side logging bug: PowerShell’s default encoding could not print icon characters when reporting failures.

I’ll make the verifier’s failure logs UTF-8-safe, then fix the natural comparator so hidden names and numeric chunks follow eza’s `natord` behavior more closely.
